subject: math

hotspots.label: Fraction bars
hotspots.description: Three identical-length bars cut into different numbers of equal parts — 2, 4, and 8.
hotspots.positionHint: The three horizontal bars side by side, cut into increasingly many segments.
hotspots.function: Show how dividing a whole into more parts shrinks each piece.

hotspots.label: Part size
hotspots.description: One filled part in each bar shows the part size — it shrinks as the denominator grows.
hotspots.positionHint: The single lit segment in each bar.
hotspots.function: Compares the size of a single part across different denominators.

hotspots.label: Denominator plate
hotspots.description: The bottom-number plate (denominator) that updates as the number of cuts changes.
hotspots.positionHint: The plate below the active bar showing its denominator.
hotspots.function: Shows the denominator value changing with the cut count.

visualStyleNotes: Fractions And Ratios, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. Three clean identical fraction bars in a vertical stack, each cut into a different number of equal segments, with one filled part each. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (grid-blue / amber / molecular-green from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Fraction bars: warm paper white with thin ink-grey seams (roughness ~0.5). Filled single parts: warm amber (roughness ~0.45). Cut slider: soft warm-grey rail with amber knob. Denominator plate: warm paper with ink text. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels anywhere — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: how the denominator controls part size — three identical fraction bars cut into 2, 4, and 8 equal parts, each highlighting one part.

GEOMETRY: Three stacked horizontal bars (length ~2.0, width ~0.28, vertical spacing ~0.45) at origin. From top to bottom the bars split into 2, 4, and 8 equal segments (thin seams). A cut slider on the middle bar can change its segment count (2,3,4,5,6,8) to show part size shrinking. One segment in each bar is filled (warm amber) to compare single-part sizes. Denominator plate at the front shows the changing denominator number.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) bars + seams; (2) filled single parts; (3) denominator plate.

CAMERA: head-on from +z frames the three bars and the plate; labels legible. Budget 6-11k triangles. Named nodes: Bar2, Bar4, Bar8, Seams, FilledParts, CutSlider_Knob, DenominatorPlate. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
